lines.text: A cold @soda_can sweats on a picnic table. A hand cracks it open; fizz rises.
Macro; slow motion on the fizz.

writes.note: I tightened the action and kept the order of events and the @soda_can.

reply.rationale: Cut the reaching and the connective words, keeping the can, the hand, the opening and the fizz in order. The direction is unchanged and stays last.
